title: Make a small change to your workflow
why_matters: Insight that doesn't become a behaviour change is decoration. This week, take the lesson from your week-7 mistake note and turn it into one specific change to how you work for the next two weeks. Smaller is better. A consistent small change is worth ten heroic resolutions.
steps: Look at the three-line note from earlier this week. What's the smallest possible change to your routine that would address it?
Write down the change as a behaviour, not a value. "I'll send the meeting summary within four hours" beats "I'll be more proactive in communication".
Set yourself a two-week timebox. At the end, you'll evaluate.
Tell one person — your line manager or a peer. Public commitment is the cheapest enforcement mechanism.
success_criteria: A two-week behaviour change is written down, dated, and someone else knows about it. By the end of week 9 you'll have either kept it or learned why you didn't.
reflection_prompt: Is this change something you want to keep forever, or just for the next two weeks? Why?
